_comment: A 'true' whoop for the sim-to-sim test of the pipeline (synthetic flights -> identification -> training -> evaluation): it differs from whoop_nominal.json on purpose, in what identification has to find. Changes: thrust curve x1.10 (each coefficient), both motor time constants x1.25, body drag x1.30 (each component), plate C_N90 x1.20, plate K_px x0.85. Everything that is measured on the bench (mass, geometry, inertia, torque constant, plate size, K_pz, C_T, e0) is the nominal value. Same format as whoop_nominal.json, so the simulator (--params), the identification and generate_params.py can all read it.

plate._coefficients: C_N90 nominal 1.15 x 1.20, K_px nominal 0.84 x 0.85; the others nominal
